example.title: Thorson Block, 200 Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-316 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,62-WEST,1-)

brief: Two-storey commercial block of 1905 built by the local firm of Theo. Thoreson in rusticated concrete block, with a symmetrical front: three upper windows with cross-muntined transoms, moulded horizontal bands and a projecting sheet-metal cornice carrying the name 'THORSON'. The ground floor has a wood-shingled pent roof over a plain modern storefront with one big display window and doors at each side.
